title: mdfor.dev: Write markdown
summary: A 30 s launch film for a markdown editor. It opens with literal markdown being typed in mono ('# Wr', '*markdown*') that converts live into rendered serif type, the words then tumble and explode into a radial burst that resolves into the logo, followed by a run of numbered feature cards (Instant live preview, Stays on your device, Lint as you write, Easy on the eyes, Take it anywhere) with small rebuilt UI beside each, a dark icon-grid 'Fast. Portable.' beat and a logo close. Warm paper tones, editorial, very crafted.
fit_reason: The 'numbered feature = serif headline with italic accent line + one small rebuilt UI vignette' system is a ready-made template for SaaSSuite feature launches and carousels; calm, premium, no hype.

palette.mood: warm paper / off-white with rust accent, soft vignette, then warm charcoal dark mode

typography.display: heavy high-contrast serif (GT Super / Recoleta-like) roman for line 1, same serif italic in rust for line 2; monospace (JetBrains/IBM Plex Mono) for raw markdown and eyebrows
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred for the opener, then left-column 2-line headlines (~7% height) with tiny body copy
typography.notes: Eyebrow format: '01 — LIVE PREVIEW' in tiny tracked mono rust. Each headline = roman line + italic rust line ending with a period ('Lint as / you write.').

text_animation: typewriter in mono with caret, markdown syntax chars in rust
syntax-to-render morph: mono '*markdown*' re-sets letter by letter into italic serif while asterisks fly off as particles (3.1 s)
per-letter scatter/tumble in 3D then implode to a point (6.3-7.3 s)
logo wordmark letters drop in with blur and settle (8.1 s)
feature headlines mask up line by line
motion: floating markdown tokens as little UI chips ('bold', '| quote', '✓ done', 'render()') drifting around the title
radial line burst with a rust dot centre, then concentric ring ripple
particles of markdown glyphs (#, *, [ ], >) orbit and spiral into the logo
editor UI card tilts in 3D then flattens
transitions: crossfade to dark mode for the 'Easy on the eyes' beat (theme switch as transition)
particle disperse into the end logo
graphic_elements: small white chip tokens with shadow
dark grid of tool icons with a few rust-highlighted tiles
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI, simplified; full editor in a tilted floating window early, then tiny focused vignettes (two-pane preview, lint popover, export dropdown) next to each feature headline

sound.sfx: typing clicks, soft whooshes on bursts
sound.sync: bursts and feature changes land on musical phrases

signature_moves: raw syntax typed in mono that transforms into the finished rendered type
roman + rust italic two-line serif headlines with numbered mono eyebrows
words explode into a radial burst that becomes the logo
theme switch to dark used as a scene transition

best_segments.what: Mono markdown typed with caret, converts into serif 'Write' + rust italic 'markdown.'
Words tumble and implode, radial burst, glyph particles swirl into the logo
Numbered feature cards: serif + italic headline beside a small UI vignette
Light to dark theme switch, export dropdown, then dark icon grid 'Fast.'

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP (SplitText) or Remotion. Typewriter in mono, then crossfade per letter to serif with y/blur; 3D scatter via per-char rotationX/Y + z; radial burst as SVG lines scaled from 0; feature scenes are a reusable component (eyebrow, roman line, italic line, body, vignette).
recreate.prompt: Warm off-white #f9f5ed paper with soft vignette; mono markdown types and morphs into a heavy serif headline with a rust #b45c3c italic second line; tokens float as small white chips; words implode into a radial line burst that becomes the logo; numbered feature scenes with tiny rebuilt UI; switch to warm charcoal #1c1814 dark mode mid-film.
